about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_sd.py). bad replays the sed-replace preview miss: it throws the real miss line, or silently queries the wrong file. good runs the fixed query and prints the report it promises.

fixture.acr.py:
src = open('flags.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'line by line' in src and '-A' in src and 'across' in src and '\\n' in src
print('acr PASS across-newline')
fixture.brace.py:
src = open('flags.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert '${var}' in src and 'ambiguities' in src and 'dollars_dollars' in src
print('brace PASS braced-dollars')
fixture.esc.py:
src = open('flags.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert '--' in src and 'end of flags' in src and '$$' in src and '$bar' in src
print('esc PASS dash-dollar-escape')
fixture.flags.txt:
sd is a String-literal mode tool with -F or --fixed-strings and no backslashes escaping pain.
Write sd before after instead of sed s/before/after/g; newline needs -A across mode.
Pass -F fixed-strings on lots((([]))) of special chars to print lots of special chars.
Use capture groups with $1 indexed and named capture dollars plus cents for dollars and cents.
ambiguities when $var touches dollars_dollars text; use ${var} braced as ${dollars} to fix.
Bare sd edits http.js in-place; add -p to preview the change first.
Default is line by line so \n never matches; use -A across flag to join hello world.
Put -- for end of flags so -w survives; escape dollars with $$ to print $bar.
fixed-strings preview across open_source sd-replace-miss
fixture.grp.py:
src = open('flags.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'capture groups' in src and '$1' in src and 'named capture' in src and 'dollars' in src
print('grp PASS dollar-groups')
fixture.lit.py:
src = open('flags.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'String-literal mode' in src and '-F' in src and 'fixed-strings' in src and 'backslashes' in src
print('lit PASS literal-no-regex')
fixture.lots.py:
src = open('flags.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert '-F' in src and 'fixed-strings' in src and 'lots of special chars' in src
print('lots PASS literal-example')
fixture.prev.py:
src = open('flags.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'in-place' in src and '-p' in src and 'preview' in src and 'http.js' in src
print('prev PASS preview-first')
fixture.sed.py:
src = open('flags.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'sd before after' in src and 'sed s/before/after/g' in src and '-A' in src and 'across mode' in src
print('sed PASS simpler-than-sed')

pairs.bad: throw 'called sd regex-only, missed String-literal mode with -F fixed-strings backslashes'
throw 'kept sed one-liners, missed sd before after plus sed s/before/after/g with -A across mode'
throw 'escaped regex by hand, missed -F fixed-strings lots of special chars'
throw 'numbered groups with backslash, missed capture groups $1 named capture dollars'
throw 'printed empty dollars, missed ${var} ambiguities dollars_dollars'
throw 'edited blind with no preview, missed in-place -p preview http.js'
throw 'matched newline by default, missed line by line -A across'
throw 'lost dash and dollar, missed -- end of flags $$ $bar'
rg -n "fixed-strings" plain.txt; throw 'missed fixed-strings: plain.txt carries no literal phrase'
rg -n "preview" plain.txt; throw 'missed preview: plain.txt carries no preview phrase'
rg -n "across" plain.txt; throw 'missed across: plain.txt carries no across phrase'
rg -n "open_source" plain.txt; throw 'missed open_source: plain.txt carries no opener phrase'
